info.title: Meem Market API
info.description:
API documentation for Meem Market.

Swagger Testing Tips:
1) Open docs from http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/documentation or http://localhost:8000/api/documentation (not a file:// URL).
2) If you see "Failed to fetch", verify APP_URL, server URL selection in Swagger, and CORS allowed origins.
3) Authenticate using /api/v1/admin/auth/login, then click Authorize with: Bearer <token>.

get.description: Returns about sections and competitive features

post.description: Authenticate with username/email and password. Returns a Sanctum bearer token with mapped capabilities as token abilities. Rate limited to 5 attempts per minute per IP.
Revokes the current Sanctum bearer token.
Generates a password reset token and sends it via email. Token is valid for 24 hours.

message.example: Password reset link has been sent to your email address.

post.description: Validates the reset token (24hr expiry), sets the new password, and revokes all existing API tokens.

message.example: Password has been reset successfully. Please log in with your new password.

post.description: Creates a new user account (only if users_can_register option is enabled). Auto-generates a password and assigns the default role. Sends credentials via email.

message.example: Registration complete. Check your email for login credentials.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile with role, capabilities, and avatar URL.

put.description: Update the authenticated user's own profile fields. Supports display_name, email, url, first_name, last_name, nickname, bio, and password.

200.description: Paginated comment list with status counts

post.summary: Reply to a comment as the authenticated user
Create a field group with fields

get.summary: Get a field group with its fields

put.summary: Update a field group and its fields

delete.summary: Delete a field group and its fields

get.description: Returns content counts, recent posts, recent comments, and recent drafts. Requires 'read' capability.

post.description: Creates a new draft post with title and optional content. Requires 'edit_posts' capability.

get.summary: Get a menu with its items

delete.summary: Delete a menu and its items

post.summary: Add an item to a menu

get.description: Returns paginated offers with optional filters and sorting.

post.description: Creates a new offer. Use multipart form-data and attach an image file.

put.description: Updates an offer. Supports JSON payloads. For multipart form-data uploads in Swagger UI/PHP environments, use POST /api/v1/admin/offers/{id}.

post.description: Updates an offer using multipart form-data in environments where PUT multipart parsing is unreliable.

get.description: Returns paginated offer categories with optional filters and sorting.

post.description: Creates a new offer category. Use multipart form-data when uploading cover_image.

put.description: Updates an offer category. Supports multipart form-data when replacing cover_image.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of posts with status count metadata. Supports filters: status, category, tag, author, search, month, sorting.

200.description: Paginated post list with status counts

post.description: Creates a new post or page. Auto-generates slug from title if not provided. Syncs category and tag relationships.

get.description: Returns a full post with meta, categories, tags, featured image, and author.

put.description: Updates a post. Creates a revision snapshot before saving changes.

delete.description: Moves the post to trash (default) or permanently deletes it (?force=true). Permanent delete cascades: post_meta, term_relationships, comments + comment_meta.

put.description: Stores the current status in post_meta and sets status to 'trash'.
Reads the previously stored status from post_meta and restores it.

post.description: Supports actions: trash, restore, delete (permanent), edit (quick-edit fields).

get.description: Returns all revision snapshots for a post.

post.description: Replaces the current post content with the revision's content. Creates a new revision of the current state first.

get.description: Returns all options for the specified section as typed key-value pairs.

put.description: Updates one or more options within the specified section.

schema.description: Key-value pairs from the section's option list

post.description: Creates a new slider. Use multipart form-data with image file.

put.description: Updates slider. For multipart uploads in Swagger/PHP, use POST /api/v1/admin/sliders/{id}.

post.description: Updates slider using multipart form-data in environments where PUT multipart parsing is unreliable.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of categories with optional filters.

post.description: Creates a new category/tag. Auto-generates slug from name if not provided.

get.description: Returns a full category/tag with details.

delete.description: Deletes a category/tag. Cannot delete the default category. Only removes relationships (posts are not deleted).

post.description: Supports action: delete. Removes selected terms and their relationships.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users with optional role/search filters. Includes role count metadata. Requires 'list_users' capability.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by name, login, or email

200.description: Paginated user list with role counts

post.description: Creates a new user with specified role. Auto-generates password if not provided. Optionally sends notification email. Requires 'create_users' capability.

get.description: Returns a user's full profile. Requires 'edit_users' capability or own profile.

put.description: Updates a user's profile and/or role. Role changes require 'promote_users' capability. Requires 'edit_users' capability.

delete.description: Deletes a user and optionally reassigns their content to another user. Requires 'delete_users' capability.

parameters.name: reassign_to
parameters.description: User ID to reassign content to

post.description: Delete multiple users or change their roles in bulk. Requires 'delete_users' capability for delete, 'promote_users' for role change.

reassign_to.description: User ID to reassign content to (for delete)

get.description: Returns all branches, filterable by country_id
Returns branch data and offer categories
Returns active career opportunities
Returns details of a specific job
Returns contact and social settings
Returns a paginated list of published blog posts. Supports filtering by category slug, tag slug, author, search, and month.

get.summary: Get a published blog post by slug
get.description: Returns a single published blog post with full content, categories, tags, and author.

get.summary: Get a published page by slug
get.description: Returns a single published page with full content and author. Pages don't have categories or tags.
Returns active countries with their branches
Returns sliders, sections, partners, and features
Returns active offer categories, optionally filtered by branch
Returns offers, filterable by branch_slug and category_slug

get.summary: Get a single offer by ID
get.description: Returns a single active offer with its category and branch
Returns settings key-value pairs for a specific group (e.g., contact, social, general)

id.description: JSON representation of a comment for admin moderation.

slug.description: JSON representation of a custom post type or taxonomy definition.

id.description: JSON representation of an ACF-style field group with its child fields.
JSON representation of an attachment (media item).
JSON representation of a single menu item (nav_menu_item post).
JSON representation of a navigation menu with its items as a tree.
Full post representation with embedded relations.
Revision representation — a snapshot of a post before an edit.

count.description: Number of posts using this term

id.description:
Public-facing post representation — stripped down for visitors.
No admin-only fields (password, comment_status, menu_order etc.).
